changes.summary: Optional hash used to trigger resource updates when external values change; alternative to file_content_hash for controlling when updates run.
No longer settable in configuration; now computed only (was previously optional and computed).
Optional boolean (default false) that stores the OAuth client secret in Terraform state as a sensitive value when set to true.
Populated in Terraform state only when expose_client_secret is true; otherwise remains empty in state.
file_content_hash is no longer accepted as a configuration argument; plans will fail if it remains set in .tf files.
Refresh now populates client_id in state.
client_secret is populated in state only when expose_client_secret is true; otherwise it is cleared from state during refresh.
Update no longer emits a deprecation warning when file_content_hash changes.
Create, read, and integration-credential create/update populate client_secret in state only when expose_client_secret is true.
When contacts_filepath is empty, bulk contact upload is skipped instead of returning an error.
Exported flow configurations use update_trigger_hash = filesha256(...) instead of file_content_hash to trigger updates.
label_names values are exported as references to genesyscloud_knowledge_label resources instead of plain label name strings, ensuring correct resource creation order.
Added support for the mx-central-1 region (maps to mxc1.pure.cloud).
Added support for the ap-southeast-1 region (maps to apse1.pure.cloud).
